PRE-QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:
THE BIDDER SHOULD HAVE PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE N'SUPPLY OF SAMPLE
COOLER FOR HRSG/BOILER SYSTEM TO ANY GOVERNMENT ORGANISATION /
REPUTED PRIVATE ORGANISATION. THE SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS SHOULD BE
ENCLOSED WITH THE OFFER.
Cover 1: EMD/PQR after verification Cover 2: Price bid.
1. The rate quoted should be firm and inclusive of all taxes and other charges as admissible.
2. The material should be original and specified make only.
3. The materials should be directly supplied to the PPCL site, T.R.Pattinam, Karaikal - 609 606,
on door delivery basis.
4. 100% payment will be made within 30 days from the date of receipt of your invoice after
receipt of materials at site in good condition. The bill in triplicate along with advance
stamped receipt should be sent to the undersigned for effecting payment.
5. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT: An Earnest Money Deposit of Rs.710/- should be paid by
demand draft drawn in favour of The Executive Engineer (Mech.) Plant, Puducherry Power
Corporation Ltd TR. Pattinam, Karaikal on any Nationalized/Schedule bank payable at Karaikal.
The same should be enclosed along with tender/quotation failing which tender will be summarily
rejected. The earnest money deposit will bear no interest and will be released after successful
completion of the supply and acceptance. The EMD willbe returned to unsuccessful bidder on
receipt of a letter requesting for the same after placement of order to the successful bidder.

the Officer shall proceed further with opening the tender. In case the carnest money is not
deposited or is not in order, the tender will be rejected.
8. The delivery period and mode of despatch should be clearly specified.
Fax: 04368 - 233355.
9. Liquidity Damage Clause: If the supplier fails to supply the materials within the delivery
period, then supplier shall pay LD @0.5% for each week delay in supply and the total LD % willbe
subject to the maximum of 5% of the quoted rate.
10.Warranty/Guarantee: Party should provide warranty /Guarantee certificate for a period of
18 months (eighteen months) from the date of receipt of the shipment or 12 month (Twelve
months from the date of installation for satisfactory operation and good workmanship.
11. The party attheir own cost should arrange transit insurance, if necessary.
12. Quotations should be super scribed as "QUOTATION/ENQUIRY NO. AC-088 Supply of
Sample Cooler for HRSG system" due on 27.01.2026, 12.00PM.
13. Applicable taxes, freight and other charges should be clearly mentioned as whether
inclusive or extra. If not mentioned, it will be presumed that the rate quoted is inclusive of all
taxes and other charges.
14. Our GSTIN No.: 34AAACP6507E1ZS is registered with Commercial Taxes Department,
Puducherry.
15. The undersigned reserves all rights to accept/reject any or all the quotations without
assigning any reasons therefore.

5.Sample cooler shall be of submerged helical coil type of shell and tube design with
removable shell. The sample tube shall be of seamless with no welds and other joint
inside thecooling jacket. Unions shall be provided to facilitate removal of coils.
6.All sample tubing and fittings, other components shall be constructed of type 316
stainless steel.
8. IBR certificate is required wherever applicable.
